title: TEHRAN, October 27 - Iran’s Government Spokeswoman, Fatemeh Mohajerani, held her weekly press conference today.
text:
TEHRAN, October 27 - Iran’s Government Spokeswoman, Fatemeh Mohajerani, held her weekly press conference today."

"===================="

"SOT1, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:14): "Despite the rhetoric coming from US officials, we can see that the economy remains stable and that infrastructure investment is proceeding well.""

"SOT2, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:15 - 00:30): "One reason the current neither-war-nor-peace situation is not in the country’s interest is that when a country’s political conditions are unstable, foreign investors are naturally less inclined to enter.""

""
"SOT3, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:31 - 00:57): "They spare no effort and are openly making desperate attempts to create obstacles for the country. We saw this during the  Ramadan War, they attacked Minab and Lamerd on the first day, trying to signal, “This is how much savagery we are capable of,” even though we already knew they possessed that level of savagery.""

"SOT4, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:58 - 01:18): "[Regarding the border closures] this is a consequence of the same siege we are witnessing in the country. They have adopted a bullying approach and have also applied pressure on our maritime and land routes. However, thanks to diplomatic follow-up, the border is currently open, and movement through it is continuing.
